home.tagline: PayD is the next-gen dashboard for real-time employee payments. Secure, transparent, and ultra-fast.
home.card1Body: No more waiting for banks. Pay your staff in seconds with sub-cent fees.
home.card2Body: Onboard anyone, anywhere. Pay in USDC, XLM, or local stablecoins.
home.card3Body: Full transparency. Every transaction is immutable and verifiable on-ledger.

feeEstimation.title: Fee Estimator
feeEstimation.error: Failed to fetch fee statistics from Horizon.
feeEstimation.alertBody: The network is experiencing high traffic ({{usage}}% capacity). Consider using the recommended fee of {{fee}} stroops or higher to ensure timely processing of payroll transactions.

errorFallback.defaultDescription: The interface hit an unexpected error. The issue has been logged for review.
errorFallback.homeDescription: Reload the page or try again in a few moments.
errorFallback.payrollDescription: Your draft data is safe. Try reloading the scheduler.
errorFallback.employeesDescription: Return to the dashboard or retry in a few seconds.
errorFallback.debuggerDescription: Reset the debugger or navigate back to the main dashboard.

settings.title: Profile and Settings
settings.languageDescription: Choose your preferred language for the dashboard.
settings.webhooksDescription: Manage webhook subscriptions for your organization.
settings.twoFactorDescription: Protect your admin account with a TOTP authenticator app.

webhooks.title: Webhook Subscriptions
webhooks.subtitle: Send real-time event notifications to your own endpoints.
webhooks.secretDescription: Used to sign the payload (HMAC-SHA256). Minimum 16 characters.
webhooks.secretPlaceholder: Enter a secret of at least 16 characters
webhooks.eventsDescription: Select which events to receive. Leave empty to receive all events.
webhooks.empty: No webhook subscriptions yet. Create one above to get started.

errors.secretTooShort: Secret must be at least 16 characters long.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.subtitle: Admin accounts can require a one-time code from an authenticator app at login.
twoFactor.statusEnabledDescription: Login requires a code from your authenticator app. You have {{count}} unused recovery codes left.
twoFactor.statusDisabledDescription: Your account is protected by a single factor only. Turn on 2FA to require a one-time code at login.
twoFactor.enableDescription: Generate a secret and scan it with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, 1Password or Aegis.
twoFactor.scanDescription: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows to finish enrolling.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for setting up two-factor authentication
twoFactor.recoveryDescription: Store these somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose access to your authenticator, and they are shown only now.
twoFactor.disableDescription: Enter a current code from your authenticator app. Recovery codes are not accepted here.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load your two-factor status.

twoFactor.loginDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
twoFactor.loginRecoveryHint: Lost your device? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.
